note: Production briefs. Presence here does not mean an animation is rendered or published; current status is recorded separately in next-twenty.json.

cards.title: Infinite Rizz: Domain Expansion: Main Character
cards.tagline:
Untouchable confidence.
Unrecoverable embarrassment.
descriptions: A white-haired show-off lifts the edge of his black blindfold.
He makes a finger seal above the neon city.
A domain grows around his intact body while an incoming attack slows to a stop.
Infinity holds the attack at a humiliating distance and returns the entire gesture.
He relaxes into a smug victory pose.
His blindfold slips. He tries to rescue his dignity while the domain keeps working.

cards.title: Big Bald Energy: One Punch, One Coupon
cards.tagline:
A perfectly ordinary punch.
An extraordinary discount.
descriptions: A bored bald hero checks his grocery coupon.
He waits outside a battered discount supermarket with his shopping bag.
One restrained punch travels through eight whole-body drawings.
A giant shock front clears the forecourt while his groceries stay safe.
He immediately checks the coupon again.
The coupon expired yesterday. The victory receives no further attention.

cards.title: The Eternal 2nd: Runner-Up Final Flash
cards.tagline:
Maximum power.
Consistent placement.
descriptions: A furious black-haired warrior expects to win this time.
He braces in an empty tournament arena.
His hands come together and thrust forward as the enormous beam charges.
A colossal golden beam tears across the arena.
He waits for his award, already smiling.
A silver medal arrives. The podium still says second place. He has a very small tantrum.

cards.title: Sauron Surveillance: One Eye to Track Them All
cards.tagline:
Search history acquired.
Cookies are mandatory.
descriptions: A flaming surveillance eye narrows inside a spiked black tower.
The tower watches an empty corporate courtyard through its attached cameras.
A scanning cone sweeps the street and creates a fictional profile.
An impossibly long privacy policy crashes through the courtyard.
The eye tries to keep its terrifying stare as cookies gather below.
The eye also accepts all cookies. The privacy policy remains enormous.

cards.title: Fraudo Baggins: One Ring to Refer Them All
cards.tagline:
A once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
For every new referral.
descriptions: A smiling hobbit shows a tiny gold ring.
He opens his investment pitch in a suspiciously welcoming Shire courtyard.
He throws the ring and it grows into a gigantic gold referral loop.
The loop sweeps a wall of guaranteed-return claims across the courtyard.
The welcome carpet begins rolling out from under him.
The carpet unravels the entire pitch. The conman lands flat and tries to keep smiling.

cards.title: Daenerys Airfryer: Dracarys, Preheat
cards.tagline:
Mother of countertop appliances.
Breaker of cooking timers.
descriptions: A platinum-haired queen commands the room.
Three black dragon-head air fryers wait in the throne-room kitchen.
Her grand command is answered by a preheating countdown.
All three appliances launch a small scorched projectile after the ready chime.
She waits for an appropriately royal result.
The queen inspects one tiny crisped morsel. The appliances are very pleased with themselves.

cards.title: Light Yagamod: Ban Note
cards.tagline:
One username.
Total control.
descriptions: A smug moderator opens a black notebook.
He raises his pen beside a wall of glowing moderation screens.
One furious written username unleashes a wave of ban notices.
An enormous ban stamp slams across the monitors.
He admires the perfect purge, then notices a missing channel.
The appeal channel and tech support are both gone. The moderator stares at his notebook in panic.

cards.title: Copy-Paste Kakashi: Photocopy Jutsu
cards.tagline:
A thousand techniques.
One office printer.
descriptions: A masked silver-haired ninja prepares a copied technique.
He leans over a photocopier in a very suspicious dojo.
The printer produces a paper clone of the entire ninja.
The clone charges in the wrong direction while watermarked paper flies across the room.
The original tries to make sense of the printed instructions.
He holds the instructions upside down. The clone has no paper handling skills.

cards.title: L Ratio: Case Closed, Ratio Open
cards.tagline:
Perfect evidence.
Catastrophic replies.
descriptions: An exhausted detective studies his black tablet.
He inspects an empty alley through an enormous magnifying glass.
A barrage of evidence cards travels toward the reply board.
Every point receives a perfect verdict, then a huge letter L lands on the board.
He checks the public reply count and cannot believe it.
The evidence is still correct. The detective has been comprehensively ratioed.

cards.title: Yasuo 0/10: Windwall of Excuses
cards.tagline:
One flawless sword technique.
Ten flawless excuses.
descriptions: A disheveled swordsman prepares his weapon.
The neon street splits into two very clear lanes.
He dashes forward through an elaborate wind wall.
The slash clears the wrong exit and the defeat counter reaches ten.
He finally notices the scoreboard.
The tenth defeat is definitely everyone else's fault.

cards.title: Erwin LinkedIn: Dedicate Your Quarterly Results
cards.tagline:
Your sacrifice matters.
To the growth graph.
descriptions: A stern blond commander prepares a motivational address.
He raises his arm on a battered office-district avenue.
His charge sends a column of employee ID cards into a rising graph.
The graph rockets upward through the quarterly report.
He stands proudly waiting for his promotion.
A tiny promotion badge is pinned to the graph. The commander remains middle management.

cards.title: Gandalf the Grey Market: You Shall Not Audit
cards.tagline:
A wizard is never licensed.
He invoices precisely when he means to.
descriptions: A scruffy grey wizard grips his staff.
He guards a suspicious market doorway.
The staff strikes the ground and illegal magical receipts spiral around him.
A rolling shop shutter crashes down across the inspection entrance.
The wizard quietly opens a small side hatch.
The grand magical defense is an unlicensed shop. Cash only.

cards.title: GenOS Windows Update: Restart Required
cards.tagline:
An unstoppable transformation.
Pending installation.
descriptions: A damaged cybernetic fighter prepares an upgrade.
His intact body braces in an empty repair bay.
A progress ring climbs toward maximum power and stops at ninety-nine percent.
The upgrade finally fires an enormous blast into the repair target.
He waits silently for the system to confirm victory.
The startup chime arrives embarrassingly late. Another restart is already pending.

cards.title: Sully Sullivan HR: Mandatory Monster Wellness
cards.tagline:
Please enjoy your wellbeing.
Attendance is compulsory.
descriptions: A huge furry monster practices a professional smile.
He prepares a mandatory wellness session in a grubby office.
The monster opens his arms and gathers a protective blanket.
His motivational roar sends a wall of performance reviews across the office.
An employment notice lands in front of him.
He has been fired for scaring employees. The severance blanket still protects the squad.

cards.title: Olaf Global Warming: Sponsored Cold Front
cards.tagline:
This cooling campaign
is brought to you by the heatwave.
descriptions: A worried snowman tries to look cheerful.
He starts a sponsored cooling campaign on a blazing city street.
The intact snowman whips up a cold front while his confidence melts.
A giant portable fan sweeps snow and cool air across the street.
He checks the heat and then looks at the fan.
The snowman needs the fan more than anyone else. The sponsorship sign stays very expensive.

cards.title: Dutch Pyramid Scheme: I Have a Payment Plan
cards.tagline:
One more payment.
Then we all retire.
descriptions: A swaggering outlaw promises a brilliant new plan.
He presents a payment contract in an empty frontier town.
Golden invoices stack into a massive triangular pyramid.
The pyramid crashes across the street under its own subscription fees.
The outlaw brushes himself off and examines the wreckage.
He immediately unfolds another blank contract. This next plan is definitely different.

cards.title: Absent Father: Instant Abandonment
cards.tagline:
Unmatched power.
Unreachable parent.
descriptions: A confident spiky-haired fighter prepares for battle.
He takes his stance on a tournament concourse.
An enormous charge builds around his intact body.
A family bill appears and the fighter vanishes in a single movement.
The empty concourse waits beside the untouched bill.
A departure slip remains where he stood. The family bill is still unpaid.

cards.title: Anti-Anti-Meat Activist: Barbecue Liberation
cards.tagline:
Freedom for the barbecue.
Justice for absolutely no salad.
descriptions: A furious straw-hatted pirate spots a threat to lunch.
He stands between a rooftop barbecue and a bowl of salad.
His whole body lunges into a wild liberation attack.
The attack sends the salad bowl spinning while the barbecue remains safe.
He solemnly checks the rescued food.
He celebrates the wrong moral victory with an enormous meal.

cards.title: Power of Friendship: Flashback Barrage
cards.tagline:
One more memory.
Then we finish the attack.
descriptions: A determined young fighter remembers a promise.
He braces in a battered training courtyard.
Whole-body memories gather in picture panels as the charge grows.
The panels fly forward as an overwhelming friendship barrage.
The hero begins one last inspirational recollection.
The attack has accumulated so many memories that its own ending needs a recap.

cards.title: Touch Grass Final Boss: Offline Rehabilitation
cards.tagline:
Your session has ended.
Please acknowledge the outdoors.
descriptions: An imposing outdoor guardian prepares to intervene.
The city park grows quiet around him.
A gigantic leaf sweeps forward through a stream of disconnected notification cards.
The leaf drags the entire incident offline.
The guardian takes a satisfied breath of fresh air.
A tiny phone lights up. The final boss immediately checks the notification.
